title.rendered: ROSÉ – GRAMMY Museum Spotlight Live Performance – Los Angeles

content.rendered:
The GRAMMY Museum announced that 3-time 2026 GRAMMY Award nominee ROSÉ will appear at the Museum’s intimate Clive Davis Theater for a special evening event. The program will highlight her nominations for Song of the Year, Record of the Year, and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance for “APT.”

During the session, ROSÉ will discuss the creative process behind the song, her nominations for Song of the Year, Record of the Year, and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance for “APT.,” share insights into her solo debut album, and deliver an exclusive live performance for the 200-seat audience.
